subject: Entire workspace is down
body: Since 09:12 UTC none of our 850 users can load the app. We get a 502 on every page. This is a complete outage for us.

subject: SSO login loop after SAML update
body: After we rotated our IdP certificate, every login bounces back to the SSO page. Nobody in the company can get in.

subject: API returning 429 constantly
body: Our integration started getting rate limited an hour ago even though we are well under our contracted limits. Production jobs are failing.

subject: Duplicate charge on this month's invoice
body: We were charged twice for October. Invoice INV-5531 appears two times on the card statement.

subject: Cannot export dashboard to PDF
body: PDF export spins forever and then shows an error. CSV works fine. The dashboard has about 25 widgets.

subject: Webhooks delivered twice
body: We are seeing every webhook event delivered two times since yesterday. Our handler is idempotent but it doubles our load.

subject: Feature request: dark mode for reports
body: Would love to have a dark theme for the reports page. Not urgent, just nice to have.

subject: Mobile app not syncing
body: iOS app shows data from three days ago. Reinstalled twice, same thing.

subject: Refund request
body: I subscribed by accident yesterday and would like a refund please.

subject: How do I change my email address?
body: I want to switch my account to a different email. Where is the setting?

subject: Please delete my account and data
body: I am no longer using the product. Please delete all my data under GDPR.

subject: Export CSV has wrong encoding
body: Non-ASCII characters come out garbled in the CSV export. Looks like it is not UTF-8.

subject: Slack integration stopped posting
body: Our alerts channel has not received anything since the weekend. Reconnecting the integration did not help.

subject: Data residency question for EU users
body: Our DPA requires EU data residency. Can you confirm where our data is stored and processed?

subject: Intermittent 502 errors in production
body: Roughly 5% of requests fail with 502 since this morning. Retries succeed. Our customers are noticing.

subject: Need an invoice with our PO number
body: Finance will not pay the invoice unless it carries PO-88213. Can you reissue it?

subject: Can't add a new user, seat limit reached
body: We are at 40/40 seats. How do we add more?

subject: Jira integration creating duplicate issues
body: Every ticket we sync creates two Jira issues. Started after the latest integration update.

subject: Rate limit docs are wrong
body: The docs say 1000 requests/minute for Pro but we get throttled at 600.

subject: Android app crashes on launch
body: Since the last update the Android app crashes immediately on launch. Pixel 8, Android 15.

subject: Idea: keyboard shortcut for new task
body: It would be great to press N to create a task.

subject: Locked out of my account
body: I forgot my password and the reset email never arrives. Checked spam.

subject: Is there a student discount?
body: I am a student and wondering if there is an education plan.

subject: Webhook signature verification fails
body: The X-Signature header does not match the HMAC I compute from the body. Which secret should I use?

subject: GDPR deletion request for former employee
body: A former employee has requested deletion of their personal data. Our DPA requires a 7-day turnaround.

subject: Exports time out for large tables
body: Any export over 50k rows times out instead of being emailed.

subject: Security question: SOC 2 report
body: Our auditors need your latest SOC 2 Type II report under NDA.

subject: Mobile sync shows stale data
body: Field technicians see yesterday's schedule on their phones. Desktop is fine.

subject: Charged after cancelling
body: We cancelled on the 2nd but were charged on the 5th. Please refund.

subject: Status page did not update during yesterday's incident
body: Your status page stayed green while the API was down for 40 minutes. We need better comms.
